initial_requirements: The Southwest Florida Water Management District needs a GIS-based Water Use Tracking System for District employees and external customers. The system should support spatial and temporal analysis of regulatory and resource-management data, particularly permitted and actual water use. It is intended to replace inconsistent manual and semi-automated analyses and help staff evaluate water-use trends and assess the effects of management rules.
